question: Can identical complete native source states yield candidate-alpha/direction/preparation dependent contact labels?
data_role: Four familiar DEV source states selected by fixed metadata; bounded label feasibility, not independent generalization or predictor training.
stop_rule: Exactly72 new9s suffixes/129600newlower/0optimizer; no prefix replay, oldbranch cache, force/state/alpha search or automatic expansion.
replanning: One shot from own measured state when abs execution cross-track >1m OR follower invalid, at task1..9s boundaries; original worldgoal unchanged; no true force/onset/end information.
ordering: All candidate scalar alpha0/.5/1 apply immediately at common source task1 and hold; pulse onset1+prep. Source task1 common planner runs before publication. Origin defines state only, no ongoing hybrid.
interpretation: Primary no-contact includes preparation and pulse fromsource through pulseEND+3s (task4.1/4.3/4.7). Pre-pulse contact is negative; numerical faults invalid, never successful survival. Goal arrival and fullH10 contact separate.
scoring: True contact/physicalfailure labels and engineering invalid separate; user1 costs diagnostic, missedgoal notfall.
normalization: Original native frame/context scales and archived H75 architecture; no learned observation normalizer.
timing_rationale: Candidate applied at source task1 for every case; preparation0/.2/.6 controls pulse onset1/1.2/1.6 only. No ongoing source-origin action after branch.

decision_rules.feasibility: Report per-source scalar-alpha/direction/preparation contact labels. Candidate/direction/preparation separation motivates later predictor review; all-positive labels do not authorize training a trivial classifier.
decision_rules.negative: Preserve no-separation, pre-pulse contacts and engineeringinvalid; no force/state/threshold expansion.
decision_rules.outcomes: Primary source-through-pulseEND+3s contact/physicalfailure; fullH10 and goal independent, missedgoal neverfall.

geometry_support: Original S samples and worldgoal unchanged; only straight support may extend to common planner shape, without resampling original points.
initialization: Gather complete131leaf source task1 state rows0/9/18/27 without any env/lower/filter/history/ESO reset;18 exact initialcopies/source. Copy host originalgoal/arrival/replan/path.
source_features: Native351 observation at source on saved executionpath, useralpha1, before source planner. No candidatealpha/preptime/force/onset/outcome in sourcefeature vector; full hiddenstate separately preserved.
